svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Forward Deployed Engineer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Engineering Baseline: Engineering Foundations, Git and pull requests, TypeScript, Python, Linux and the shell, Data structures and algorithms, System design; 02 Full-Stack Delivery: React and Next.js, Node.js APIs, API design, PostgreSQL and migrations, Automated testing, Code review; 03 Data: Reading an unfamiliar schema, Checking data quality, SQL for analysis, Data pipelines and scheduled jobs, Data classification; 04 Applied AI: How LLMs work, Prompt and context engineering, Retrieval and vector search, Tool use and MCP, AI agents, Choosing models and providers, Evaluations; 05 AI-Assisted Delivery: Coding agents, Delegation levels and the Red Zone, Agent rules, permissions and CI, Reviewing agent output, Building prototypes with AI agents; 06 Integration Engineering: Working with legacy systems, Integration patterns, Single sign-on (SSO) integration, Email, ticketing and ERP integration, Access and release approvals; 07 Cloud and Operations: One cloud platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Logs, metrics, traces and alerts, Incidents and maintenance; 08 Production and Security: Evaluation in CI and production, Guardrails and fallbacks, Tracing AI requests, Cost and latency, AI security, Application security, Privacy and data protection law; 09 Client Delivery: Discovery, Scoping and estimation, Stakeholder management, Status updates and technical writing, Demos and executive reporting, ROI and time to value, User acceptance testing and handover, Reusable components and field notes
svg.text: Delegation levels and the Red Zone
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
